paragraphs: As of April 30, 2026, Casey's General Stores, Inc. and its direct and indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries operate convenience stores primarily under the names "Casey's" and "Casey's General Store" (collectively, with the stores below referenced as "GoodStop (by Casey's)" or "CEFCO", referred to as "Casey's" or the "Company") throughout 19 states, approximately half of which are located in Iowa, Missouri and Illinois.

As of April 30, 2026, there were 2,944 stores in operation. Approximately 71% of all stores were opened in areas with populations of fewer than 20,000 persons. The Company competes on the basis of traditional features of convenience store operations such as location, extended hours, product offerings, price and quality of service.

All stores carry a broad selection of food items (which at most stores includes, but is not limited to, prepared foods such as regular and breakfast pizza, donuts, hot breakfast items, and hot and cold sandwiches), beverages, tobacco and nicotine products, groceries, health and beauty aids, automotive products, and other non-food items. As of April 30, 2026, 241 store locations offered car washes. In addition, all but six store locations offer fuel.

In addition to the "Casey's" and "Casey's General Stores" brands, the Company also operates a limited number of stores under the additional brands of "GoodStop (by Casey's)" or "CEFCO". These locations offer fuel for sale, and a broad selection of snacks, beverages, tobacco and nicotine products, and other essentials. However, some of these locations do not have a full-service kitchen and, therefore, have limited prepared food offerings. When the Company acquires stores, the locations are typically re-branded as "Casey's" as soon as the store is remodeled to include a full-service kitchen. If the store's layout or location does not allow for a full-service kitchen, the store typically will be operated as "GoodStop (by Casey's)" or the acquired brand.

The Company operates a wholesale network where Casey's manages wholesale fuel supply agreements to certain dealer sites and other wholesale locations. The dealer and wholesale locations are not operated by Casey's and are not included in our overall store count. Approximately 3% of total revenue for the year-ended April 30, 2026 relates to the wholesale fuel network.

The Company operates three distribution centers, through which certain grocery and general merchandise and prepared food and dispensed beverage items are supplied to most of our stores. One distribution center is adjacent to our corporate headquarters, which we refer to as the Store Support Center, in Ankeny, Iowa. The other two distribution centers are located in Terre Haute, Indiana and Joplin, Missouri. Additionally, the Company owns and operates a fuel terminal in Waco, Texas. The Company self-distributes the majority of fuel to our stores. The Company had a fleet of over 500 tractors used for distribution as of April 30, 2026.

The Company's internet address is www.caseys.com. We make available through our website all of our SEC filings, including current reports on Form 8-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, our annual report on Form 10-K, and amendments to those reports, free of charge as soon as reasonably practicable after they have been electronically filed with the SEC. Additionally, you can go to our website to read our Financial Code of Ethics for the CEO and Senior Financial Officers, Corporate Governance Guidelines, Code of Conduct and Ethics, Supplier Code of Conduct, and Committee Charters. In the event of a waiver from, or updates to, the Code of Conduct and Ethics, any required disclosure will be posted to our website.

Casey's, with its principal business office, and Store Support Center, located at One SE Convenience Blvd., Ankeny, Iowa 50021-8045 (telephone 515-965-6100), was incorporated in Iowa in 1967. Our fiscal year runs from May 1 through April 30 of each year.

Casey's corporate purpose is to make life better for communities and guests every day. Many of the smaller communities in which we operate are often not served by national-chain convenience stores. We have succeeded in operating stores in smaller towns by offering, at competitive prices, a broader selection of products than does a typical convenience store. We have also succeeded in meeting the needs of residents in larger communities with these same offerings. We currently own most of our real estate, including substantially all of our stores, all three distribution centers (see discussion of ownership structure of the distribution center in Joplin, Missouri in Note 7), a fuel terminal, a construction and support services facility located in Ankeny, Iowa, and the Store Support Center facility.

The Company derives its revenue primarily from the retail sale of fuel and the products offered inside our stores. Our sales historically have been strongest during the first and second fiscal quarters (May through October) relative to the third and fourth fiscal quarters (November through April). In warmer weather, guests tend to purchase greater quantities of fuel and certain convenience items such as beer, sports drinks, water, soft drinks, and ice.

Casey's Marketing Company ("CMC") and Casey's Services Company ("CSC") were organized as Iowa corporations in March 1995. Casey's Retail Company ("CRC") was organized as an Iowa corporation in April 2004. CGS Stores, LLC was organized as an Iowa limited liability company in April 2019. CMC, CSC, and CRC are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Casey's General Stores, Inc., while CGS Stores, LLC is a wholly-owned subsidiary of CMC.

CRC owns and/or operates certain stores in Illinois, Kansas, Michigan, Minnesota, Nebraska, North Dakota, and South Dakota, holds the rights to the Company's trademarks, service marks, trade names, and other intellectual property, and performs most corporate and strategic functions of the enterprise. CMC owns and/or operates stores in Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Missouri, Ohio, Oklahoma, Wisconsin, and Texas, and is responsible for wholesale operations, including all three distribution centers and management of the wholesale fuel network. CGS Stores, LLC owns and/or operates stores in Tennessee. CSC provides a variety of construction, maintenance and transportation services for all stores.

At the end of the fiscal year, the Company formed CARES Captive Insurance Company, LLC, an Iowa limited liability company, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Casey's General Stores, Inc., to facilitate its captive insurance program.

The Company delivers value to its guests through a differentiated product assortment where the right products are optimally placed, priced and promoted to drive traffic, revenue and profit. It is our practice to continually make additions and changes to the Company's product line, especially products with higher margins such as prepared food and our private label offerings, described below. To facilitate the prepared food offering, we have installed full-service kitchens in almost all stores. For stores acquired without full-service kitchens, we typically add a full kitchen as part of the conversion or remodel process, at which point they are also converted to the Casey's brand.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business Operations
We may be adversely impacted by increases in the cost of food ingredients and other related costs.
We could be adversely affected if we experience difficulties in, or are unable to recruit, hire or retain, members of our leadership team and other distribution, field and store Team Members.
Any failure to anticipate and respond to changes in consumer preferences, or to introduce and promote innovative technology for guest interaction, could adversely affect our financial results.
Increased credit card expenses could lead to higher operating expenses and other costs for the Company.
Our operations present hazards and risks which may not be fully covered by insurance, if insured.
The dangers inherent in the storage and transport of fuel could cause disruptions and could expose to us potentially significant losses, costs or liabilities.
Consumer or other litigation could adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.

Covenants in our Senior Notes and credit facility agreements require us to comply with certain covenants and meet financial maintenance tests. Failure to comply with these requirements could have a material impact to us.
Risks Related to Governmental Actions, Regulations, and Oversight
Compliance with and changes in tax laws could adversely affect our performance.
We are subject to extensive governmental regulations.
Governmental action and campaigns to discourage tobacco and nicotine use and other tobacco products may have a material adverse effect on our revenues and gross profit.
Wholesale cost and tax increases relating to tobacco and nicotine products could affect our operating results.
General economic and political conditions that are largely out of the Company's control may adversely affect the Company's financial condition and results of operations.
Developments related to fuel efficiency, fuel conservation practices, climate change, and changing consumer preferences may decrease the demand for motor fuel.
Unfavorable weather conditions can adversely affect our business.
The volatility of wholesale petroleum costs could adversely affect our operating results.
The convenience store industry is highly competitive.
Risks Related to Our Growth Strategies
We may not be able to identify, acquire, and integrate new properties and stores, which could adversely affect our ability to grow our business.
Risks Relating to Our Common Stock
The market price for our common stock has been and may in the future be volatile, which could cause the value of your investment to decline.
Any issuance of shares of our common stock in the future could have a dilutive effect on your investment.
Iowa law and provisions in our charter documents may have the effect of preventing or hindering a change in control and adversely affecting the market price of our common stock.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the risks described in this report before making a decision to invest in our securities. If any of such risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, and/or results of operations could be materially adversely affected. In that case, the trading price of our securities could decline and you might lose all or part of your investment.

Our business and our reputation could be adversely affected by a cyber or data security incident or the failure to protect sensitive guest, Team Member or supplier data, or the failure to comply with applicable regulations relating to data security and privacy.

In the normal course of our business, we obtain, are provided and have access to large amounts of personal data, including but not limited to credit and debit card information, personally identifiable information and other data from and about our guests, Team Members, and suppliers. A compromise or a breach in our systems, or another data security or privacy incident that results in the loss, unauthorized release, disclosure or acquisition of such data or information, or other sensitive data or information, or other internal or external cyber or data security threats, including but not limited to viruses, denial-of-service attacks, phishing attacks, social engineering attacks, ransomware attacks and other intentional or unintentional disruptions, could occur and have a material adverse effect on our operations and ability to operate, reputation, operating results and financial condition. The rapid evolution and increased adoption of artificial intelligence technologies may also heighten our cybersecurity risks by making cyber-attacks more difficult to detect, contain, and mitigate. In addition, similar events at vendors, third-party service providers or other market participants, whether or not we are directly impacted, could negatively affect our business and supply chain or lead to a general loss of guest confidence, which could result in reduced guest traffic and sales.

A data security or privacy incident of any kind could expose us to risk in terms of the loss, unauthorized release, disclosure or acquisition of sensitive guest, Team Member or supplier data, and could result in litigation or other regulatory action being brought against us and damages, monetary and other claims made by or on behalf of the payment card brands, guests, Team Members, shareholders, financial institutions and governmental agencies, or monetary demands or other extortion attempts from cybercriminals. Such events could give rise to substantial monetary damages and/or losses which are not covered, or in some instances fully covered, by our insurance policies and which could adversely affect our reputation, results of operations, financial condition and liquidity. Moreover, a data security or privacy incident could require that we expend
significant additional resources on mitigation efforts and to further upgrade the security and other measures that we employ to guard against, and respond to, such incidents.

Food-safety issues and foodborne illnesses, whether actual or reported, or the failure to comply with applicable regulations relating to the transportation, storage, preparation or service of food, could adversely affect our business and reputation.

paragraphs: 截至2026年4月30日，Casey's General Stores, Inc.及其直接及間接全資子公司，主要在19個州以"Casey's"及"Casey's General Store"（合稱為"GoodStop (by Casey's)"或"CEFCO"，簡稱為"Casey's"或"本公司"）之名經營便利商店。
截至2026年4月30日，共有2,944家商店正在營運。約71%的商店位於人口少於20,000人的地區。本公司競爭優勢在於便利商店傳統運營特徵，如位置、營業時間、商品種類、價格與服務品質。
所有商店均提供廣泛的食品選項（包含但不僅限於常規與早餐披薩、甜甜圈、熱早餐商品與熱冷三明治等烹飪食品）、飲料、煙草與尼古丁產品、雜貨、健康與美容用品、汽車用品及其他非食品商品。截至2026年4月30日，241家商店提供洗車服務。此外，除了6家商店外，所有商店均提供燃油。

除了"Casey's"及"Casey's General Stores"品牌外，本公司亦經營少量商店於"GoodStop (by Casey's)"或"CEFCO"品牌。這些商店提供燃油銷售，以及廣泛的零食、飲料、煙草與尼古丁產品及其他必需品。然而，部分商店並未設有全功能廚房，因此提供的烹飪食品選擇有限。當本公司收購商店時，商店在翻新後設有全功能廚房時，通常會立即重新品牌為"Casey's"。若商店的佈局或位置無法設置全功能廚房，則通常以"GoodStop (by Casey's)"或收購品牌進行營運。
本公司運營一個 Wholesale 網路，Casey's 管理與部分經銷點及其他 Wholesale 地點的燃油供應協議。經銷與 Wholesale 地點並非由 Casey's 管理，也不計入我們總體商店數量。截至2026年4月30日，約3%的總營收與 Wholesale 燃油網路有關。

本公司運營三個配送中心，透過這些配送中心，部分雜貨與一般商品及烹飪食品與現制飲料會供應至我們的商店。其中一個配送中心位於我們總部旁，我們稱為 Store Support Center，位於愛荷華州安肯尼。另外兩個配送中心位於印第安那州特雷霍特與密蘇裏州約普林。此外，本公司擁有並運營位於德克薩斯州沃科的燃油儲存設施。本公司自營將絕大多數燃油配送至商店。截至2026年4月30日，本公司擁有超過500輛牽引車用於配送。

本公司網站地址為 www.caseys.com。我們透過網站提供所有向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交的文件，包括 Form 8-K 現況報告、Form 10-Q 季度報告、Form 10-K 年度報告及這些報告的更正版本，免費提供，並在這些文件電子提交後盡速提供。此外，您可透過網站閱讀本公司首席執行長與高階財務官的財務倫理守則、企業治理指引、倫理與道德守則、供應商倫理與道德守則及委員會章程。若對倫理與道德守則有任何豁免或更新，相關公告將張貼於網站上。
Casey's，其主要辦公室與 Store Support Center 位於愛荷華州安肯尼 One SE Convenience Blvd., Ankeny, Iowa 50021-8045（電話 515-965-6100），於1967年在愛荷華州註冊成立。本公司會計年度為每年5月1日至次年4月30日。

Casey's 公司宗旨為每日為社區與顧客創造更好的生活。許多我們經營的小型社區，往往沒有被全國連鎖便利商店服務。我們成功在小型城鎮經營商店，是因為我們以競爭性價格提供比一般便利商店更廣的產品選擇。我們也成功以這些相同的產品選擇滿足較大型社區居民的需求。目前我們擁有大部分的不動產，包括幾乎所有商店、三個配送中心（見第 7 註釋中關於 Joplin, Missouri 配送中心的所有權結構討論）、一個燃料中轉站、一個位於 Iowa Ankeny 的建設與支援服務設施，以及 Store Support Center 設施。
本公司主要營收來自於燃料零售銷售以及商店內提供的產品銷售。我們的銷售歷史表現通常在第一及第二會計季（5 月至 10 月）較第三及第四會計季（11 月至 4 月）為強。在較暖的天氣下，顧客傾向購買更多燃料以及某些便利商品，例如啤酒、運動飲料、水、汽水與冰。

Casey's Marketing Company（"CMC"）與 Casey's Services Company（"CSC"）於 1995 年 3 月在 Iowa 組織為 Iowa 公司。Casey's Retail Company（"CRC"）於 2004 年 4 月在 Iowa 組織為 Iowa 公司。CGS Stores, LLC 於 2019 年 4 月在 Iowa 組織為 Iowa 有限責任公司。CMC、CSC 與 CRC 為 Casey's General Stores, Inc. 的 wholly-owned 子公司，而 CGS Stores, LLC 為 CMC 的 wholly-owned 子公司。

CRC 擁有並/或經營位於 Illinois、Kansas、Michigan、Minnesota、Nebraska、North Dakota 與 South Dakota 的部分商店，擁有本公司商標、服務標章、商號及其他智慧財產權，並執行企業的大多數企業與戰略功能。CMC 擁有並/或經營位於 Alabama、Arkansas、Florida、Indiana、Iowa、Kentucky、Missouri、Ohio、Oklahoma、Wisconsin 與 Texas 的商店，並負責批發業務，包括三個配送中心與批發燃料網路的管理。CGS Stores, LLC 擁有並/或經營位於 Tennessee 的商店。CSC 為所有商店提供多樣化的建設、維護與運輸服務。
會計年度結束時，本公司成立了 CARES Captive Insurance Company, LLC，為 Iowa 有限責任公司，為 Casey's General Stores, Inc. 的 wholly-owned 子公司，以促進其自設保險計劃。

本公司透過提供差異化的產品組合，為顧客創造價值，其中正確的產品被最佳地放置、定價與促銷，以吸引人潮、營收與利潤。我們的慣例是持續對本公司產品線進行增補與調整，特別是那些毛利率較高的產品，例如預備食品與我們的自有品牌產品，如下所述。為促進預備食品的提供，我們已在幾乎所有商店安裝全功能廚房。對於未附全功能廚房的商店，我們通常在轉換或翻修過程中加入全功能廚房，此時這些商店也會轉換為 Casey's 品牌。

本財務年度之結算標誌著自2023年6月原公告之三年戰略計畫之結束。該計畫著重於三個企業目標：增加商店數量、加速食品業務、並提升營運效率，這些目標透過強固的基礎及員工經驗得以實現。本公司計畫係基於延續我們光榮的傳統及獨特優勢，透過新能力、科技、數據及流程，變得更加現代化。
本公司在三年期間表現強勁，相較於計畫中原來的目標。部分關鍵亮點包括：

headings: 與我們業務運作相關的風險
我們可能因食品原料及其他相關成本的增加而受到不利影響。
若我們在領導層團隊及其他分銷、現場及門市團隊成員的招募、聘僱或留任方面遇到困難，可能會對我們造成不利影響。
若未能預見並回應消費者偏好的變化，或未能推出及推廣用以提升顧客互動的創新科技，可能會對我們的財務結果造成不利影響。
信用卡費用的增加可能導致本公司營運費用及其他成本上升。
我們的業務運作存在潛在危險及風險，這些風險可能未被保險完全覆蓋，若投保的話。
燃料的儲存及運輸所固有的危險可能導致中斷，並可能使我們面臨潛在的重大損失、成本或責任。
消費者或其他方提起的訴訟可能對我們的財務狀況及營運結果造成不利影響。
本公司高階債券及信貸融資協議中的約束條款要求我們遵守某些約束條款並達成財務維持測試。未能遵守這些要求可能對本公司產生重大影響。
與政府行動、法規及監督相關的風險
遵守及變更稅法可能對本公司營運表現產生不利影響。
本公司需面對嚴格的政府法規監管。
政府對煙草及尼古丁產品使用及其它煙草產品的行動及倡導減少使用，可能對本公司營收及毛利率產生重大不利影響。
煙草及尼古丁產品的批發成本及稅費增加可能影響本公司營運結果。
與本公司所屬產業相關的風險
總體經濟及政治條件 largely out of the Company's control 可能對本公司財務狀況及營運結果產生不利影響。
與燃油效率、節油措施、氣候變遷及消費者偏好變動相關的發展，可能降低對運輸燃料的需求。
不利的天氣條件可能對本公司業務造成負面影響。
批發石油成本的波動可能對本公司營運成果造成負面影響。
便利商店產業競爭激烈。
與本公司成長策略相關的風險
本公司可能無法識別、取得並整合新資產與商店，這可能會對本公司擴張業務的能力造成負面影響。
與本公司普通股相關的風險
本公司普通股的市場價格已表現出且未來可能繼續出現波動，這可能會導致您的投資價值下降。
未來本公司普通股之發行可能對您的投資產生稀釋效果。
愛荷華州法律及本公司章程文件之規定，可能對控制權之變更產生防範或阻礙效果，並對本公司普通股之市場價格產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 您在決定投資本公司證券前，應謹慎考慮本報告中所列之風險。若其中任何風險實際發生，將可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況及/或營運成果造成重大不利影響。在此情況下，本公司證券之交易價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。
本公司之業務與聲譽可能因網路或資料安全事件，或未能保護敏感之旅客、員工或供應商資料，或未能遵守與資料安全及隱私權相關之適用法規而受到不利影響。

在本公司業務之正常運作過程中，我們會取得、獲得並存取大量個人資料，包括但不限於信用卡與提款卡資訊、個人可識別資訊及其他來自或關於旅客、員工及供應商之資料。若本公司系統遭竊取或遭入侵，或發生其他資料安全或隱私權事件，導致上述資料或資訊遭遺失、未經授權釋出、揭露或取得，或發生其他敏感資料或資訊之遺失，或發生其他內外部網路或資料安全威脅，包括但不限於病毒、拒絕服務攻擊、釣魚攻擊、社會工程攻擊、勒索軟體攻擊及其他有意或無意之幹擾，可能發生，並對本公司之營運及營運能力、聲譽、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。人工智慧技術之快速演進與廣泛採用，也可能透過使網路攻擊更難以偵測、控制及緩解，而提高本公司之網路安全風險。此外，即使本公司未直接受影響，若發生於供應商、第三方服務提供者或其他市場參與者之類似事件，也可能對本公司之業務與供應鏈造成負面影響，或導致旅客信心普遍下降，進而造成旅客人數減少與銷售額下降。

任何種類的資料安全或隱私權事件，可能會使我們面臨敏感客人、員工或供應商資料遺失、未經授權釋出、揭露或取得等風險，並可能導致我們被提起訴訟或其他監管行動，以及由支付卡品牌、客人、員工、股東、金融機構及政府機構所提出的財務或其它賠償請求，或由網路犯罪分子提出的財務要求或其他勒索行為。這些事件可能導致重大財務損失或損害，而這些損失或損害可能未被我們的保險政策所覆蓋，或在某些情況下完全未被覆蓋，並可能對我們的聲譽、營運結果、財務狀況及流動性產生不利影響。此外，資料安全或隱私權事件可能需要我們投入額外資源用於緩解措施，並進一步升級我們用以防範及應對這些事件的安全及其他措施。
在食品安全問題及食源性疾病，無論是實際發生或被報導，或未能遵守有關食品運輸、儲存、準備或服務的適用規範的情況下，可能會對我們的業務及聲譽產生不利影響。
